name: studyapp
description: StudyApp: turn your own study resources into notes, quizzes and a study plan.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently --names server,client --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --prefix server && npm run test:coverage --prefix client
